facts.fact: The High Commissioner for Digitalisation said a national short-term implementation plan (2025-2026) for the National Digital Transformation Strategy, with more than 500 digital projects, was approved in January 2025 by the ministerial departments.
The implementation plan for the National Digital Transformation Strategy comprises more than 500 digital projects for 2025-2026, with no cost stated.
The strategy's short-term national implementation plan runs 2025-2026.
